decisions.reason: The source identifies sensor power rails and loads but does not change the established interboard connector types, pinouts, or pin-order policy.
A same-message MODIFY already fully records the standalone LDO, activation condition, shared 3.3V rail, source OR-ing, and normal-operation source.
A same-message MODIFY already captures the battery input, AXP2101 normal-operation path, DCDC1 rating, and power-board-connected 3.3V source.
A same-message MODIFY already records the 500mA MT3608 rail and the explicitly listed 5V loads; no additional state change is required.
Identifying the I2C sensor modules and their 3.3V supply does not alter bus speed, cable length, pull-ups, or series-resistor conditioning.
The source conditionally places SK6812 LEDs on 5V depending on their version, but it does not establish whether these are the eight LEDs on the separate indicator board.
The battery voltage and AXP2101 power path do not resolve or change the battery connector's series, mounting type, or disputed pinout.
The electrical power-source explanation does not change battery connector placement, orientation, spacing, or mounting-hole clearance.
The source specifies electrical rail behavior and powered loads without changing any board dimensions, layer count, mounting, connector form, or enclosure-fit constraint.
The source contains no requirement about KiCad library portability, footprint resolution, or project-file packaging.
The power-rail and sensor-load specification does not change BOM part-number completeness, specification matching, or the established R6 values.
